title: Well worth booking in advance
text: Just my wife and I with our excellent guide, Nacho. Perfect pace for the two of us. Gardens and palaces are beautiful.
author: Michael_M

title: Must See in Granada
text: So glad I booked this tour.  Eduardo, our guide, brought a passion and knowledge of the history of the citadel, as well as for his home city of Granada.  It was great to be whisked pass lines.  The palaces and gardens and views of Granada are well worth it. Truly recommend this.
author: garyhD6911UY

title: Fantastic time in Alhambra
text: Jenny our guide was awesome. We learned so much. We talked to others who did not do a tour and they hated it because they didn’t know the history and stories behind what you see. Jenny was very informative and the grounds were beautiful. Pick up was only confusing thing but my fault I did not know I needed transportation to pick up which was hour away. But no worries took a taxi and was there on time even able to get coffee prior to tour. Also loved seeing the artisan doing his work.
author: GoinsOhio

title: Eduardo should be your guide
text: This was hands down the best tour we had in Granada. Our guide,Eduardo, was friendly and very knowledgeable. It was a joy to be taken around the Alhambra with him.
author: Jeannie_A

title: Cristian made Alhambra fun and educational. 8:00 AM tour was awesome.
text: Cristian was an excellent guide. He was knowledgeable, funny, friendly, and flexible to our interests. It was only 4 of us starting at 8:00am. I can’t imagine visiting Alhambra any other way…. Other than the much anticipated night tour!
author: Brock_B

title: Great tour with amazing guide.
text:
I can’t imagine touring Alhambra without a guide. And Matias must be one of, if not the best guide in Granada. His knowledge of Alhambra and personal experiences of he and his family add to the tour experience!  He is so passionate about Alhambra and Granada.  We assumed he was a history major based on the depth of his knowledge, but we were wrong. He brings his iPad loaded with visual aids that add so much to the story of Alhambra.  He knows all the best places from which to view the sites.

author: thigh150

title: The best
text:
Our tour guide, Matias, greeted us promptly at the entrance. He spoke perfect English and impressed us throughout the tour with his remarkable knowledge of history and his genuine passion for the Alhambra. His enthusiasm and expertise made the experience truly special.

It was a fantastic visit, and we are so grateful to Matias for making it such a memorable experience. Highly recommended!

Lena and Gene

title: Magical Way to See the Alhambra!
text: The most important thing on your vacation is TIME and this tour was a fantastic way to see one of the world’s most incredible sights. We didn’t have to worry about buying tickets because all the special admissions and palaces were included in the price. We didn’t have to wait on any lines because our amazing guide, Jennifer, planned everything to walk us through the guided tour entrances avoiding the big groups and individual ticket holders.
